marcadores.explicacao_original: Muscle is a frequent component of organs and forms a majority of the arterial wall. Muscle also forms an important component in the walls of other hollow organs, as seen in the previous image of the stomach. Smooth muscle is also present in the skin, where it is attached to hair follicles. Muscle is absent in bone, except in the walls of vessels supplying the bones.
